grouping_rationale: Dev: transactions/expiry/eviction. Validation: persistence/pubsub/streams. Source URLs, documents and topic families do not cross splits; both splits use one indexed corpus. This is topic shift, not IID or blind human evaluation.
limitations: No retrieval strategies, generation or Judge run on this dataset at freeze
Independent of public_zh.v1 source URLs; all new summaries/questions/labels remain authored by the same AI
Both splits and source texts are visible to the author; frozen validation means no score-driven edits, not author blindness
Small curated corpus, not full official documents or a production-scale benchmark
Four unanswerable cases lack instance observations; two lack product-rule sections in the indexed snapshot. Neither kind has generated-answer validation
Partial/unanswerable labels and expected facts are review rubrics, not a Chinese semantic answer grader
No independent human source audit, no official endorsement, and no automatic production configuration change
